payload.mathematical_finding: Eisenstein unit directions are not all at hex_distance 1 from origin. The six algebraic units (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), (-1,0), (0,-1), (-1,-1) all have norm 1, but hex_distance varies: (1,0)→1, (1,1)→2. Norm measures algebraic size. Hex distance measures grid topology. They are different metrics on the same space.
